num_designs.description: Number of designs to generate using RFdiffusion or Bindcraft.

seqs_per_design.description: Number of sequences to generate per design.

design_length.description: Design length. One or two dash separated values for min-max design length e.g. '60', '60-70'. Pipeline will randomly sample different sizes between these values.

input_pdb.description: Path to an input PDB file. e.g. 'target.pdb'

hotspot_residues.description: Specifies hotspot residues for binding. Comma-separated tokens, each a chain-qualified residue e.g. 'A56', a chain-qualified range e.g. 'A115-120', or a bare chain ID meaning the whole chain e.g. 'B'. e.g. 'A56,A115,A123'

flexible_residues.description: Residues whose structure should NOT be conditioned on (BoltzGen structure_groups visibility=0 / RFdiffusion contigmap.inpaint_str), useful for disordered/flexible regions e.g. loops or IDPs. Comma-separated tokens, each a chain-qualified residue e.g. 'B16', a chain-qualified range e.g. 'B10-13', or a bare chain ID e.g. 'C' meaning the whole chain is flexible. In boltzgen_motifscaff/rfd_motifscaff mode this may also reference chain A residues kept by motifscaff_spec. Used by boltzgen_denovo, boltzgen_motifscaff, rfd_motifscaff, rfd_partialdiff, and binder design with rfd_denovo/rfd_foldcond.

seq_method.description: Sequence design method. Choose from 'mpnn' (ProteinMPNN Fast-Relax) or 'fampnn' (Full-Atom MPNN).

pred_method.description: Structure prediction method. Choose from 'af2' (AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess), 'boltz' (Boltz-2), or 'af2_boltz' (run AF2 first, filter, then run Boltz-2 on the survivors).

zip_pdbs.description: Whether to compress output final designs in a tar.gz archive. If false, results will be output as uncompressed PDB files.

rank_designs.description: Whether to rank final designs by prediction quality metrics and output ranked_designs.

ranking_metric.description: Structure prediction metric to use for ranking designs (e.g., 'af2_pae_interaction', 'boltz_ipSAE_min', 'boltz_iptm'). Must match the prediction method prefix (af2_* for AlphaFold2, boltz_* for Boltz-2). If null, defaults to 'af2_pae_interaction' for AlphaFold2 or 'boltz_ipSAE_min' for Boltz-2.

max_designs.description: Maximum number of top-ranked designs to output (null = output all ranked designs)

max_seqs_per_fold.description: Maximum number of sequences per fold to keep after ranking (e.g. 4, null = no limit). Helps increase fold diversity.

run_fold_only.description: Whether to run fold design only and skip downstream stages (i.e. sequence design, prediction, and analysis)

skip_fold.description: Skip Fold Design and run Sequence Design, Structure Prediction, and Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_fold_seq.description: Skip Fold Design and Sequence Design, and run Structure Prediction and Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_fold_seq_pred.description: Skip Fold Design, Sequence Design, and Structure Prediction, and run Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_input_dir.description: Path to input files when skipping stages e.g. './rfd_results'

rfd_ckpt_override.description: Override the diffusion model checkpoint used by RFdiffusion. Choose from: 'active_site', 'base', 'base_epoch8', 'complex_base', 'complex_beta', 'complex_fold_base', 'inpaint_seq', 'inpaint_seq_fold'. RFdiffusion will automatically select a checkpoint. Not recommended to override except for 'rfd_denovo' binder mode i.e. 'complex_beta'. 'rfd_motifscaff' binder mode already defaults to 'complex_base' internally unless 'motifscaff_inpaint_seq'/'flexible_residues' is set.

rfd_noise_scale.description: Scale of noise for RFdiffusion translations (C-alpha) and rotations (frames). 1 (default) is recommended for monomer modes to increase diversity. 0-0.5 is recommended for binder modes to increase success rates.

rfd_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to RFdiffusion. e.g. 'contigmap.inpaint_str=[B165-178]'

mpnn_omitAAs.description: A string of all residue types (one letter case-insensitive) to avoid for design. Default: CX

mpnn_temperature.description: Temperature for sequence sampling. Higher values increase sequence diversity.

mpnn_checkpoint_type.description: Checkpoint type to use for ProteinMPNN. Choose from 'vanilla', 'soluble' or 'hyper' (default = 'soluble').

mpnn_checkpoint_model.description: Checkpoint model to use for ProteinMPNN. Indicates noise level used during training for backbone atoms.  Choose from 'v_48_002','v_48_010,'v_48_020','v_48_030'. (default = 'v_48_020', noised with 0.20Å Gaussian noise)

mpnn_backbone_noise.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise to add to backbone atoms. 0 = no change to backbone, 0.1-0.3 = allows mild perturbation of backbone.

mpnn_relax_max_cycles.description: Maximum number of fast relax cycles to run on each sequence. Set to zero to disable.

mpnn_relax_seqs_per_cycle.description: Number of sequences to generate between relaxation steps. The sequence with the best score will be kept.

mpnn_relax_output.description: Whether to run a relaxation cycle before saving output.

mpnn_relax_convergence_rmsd.description: Design is considered converged if the C-alpha RMSD (Å) between cycles is <= this threshold.

mpnn_relax_convergence_score.description: Design is considered converged if the improvement in score between cycles is <= this threshold.

mpnn_relax_convergence_max_cycles.description: Design is considered converged if it meets both convergence criteria for n consecutive cycles.

mpnn_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to ProteinMPNN-OpenMMRelax that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '-protein_features="full"'

fampnn_fix_target_sidechains.description: Fix target side-chain positions when performing binder sequence design (default: false)

fampnn_psce_threshold.description: Only keep sidechains below this PSCE threshold during design; null to keep all.

fampnn_temperature.description: Temperature for sequence sampling. Higher values increase sequence diversity.

fampnn_exclude_cys.description: Exclude cysteine residues from sequence design.

fampnn_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to Full-Atom MPNN that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. 'timestep_schedule.num_steps=100 seq_only=true'

uncropped_target_pdb.description: Path to uncropped target PDB file to use in structure prediction e.g. 'benchmarkdata/5o45_pd-l1_uncropped.pdb'

af2_initial_guess.description: Use an initial-guess of the target chain(s) when performing binder structure prediction. When false, AF2 will not use an initial guess. Default = true

af2_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '-recycle 3'

af2_jax_compilation_cache_dir.description: Optional existing path for the persistent JAX compilation cache used by AlphaFold2. Relative paths are resolved against the workflow launch directory. The path is bind-mounted into the container. When unset, JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR is not set.

boltz_recycling_steps.description: The number of recycling steps to use for prediction.

boltz_diffusion_samples.description: The number of diffusion samples to use for prediction.

boltz_sampling_steps.description: The number of sampling steps to use for prediction.

boltz_use_potentials.description: Use physics-based potentials during inference to improve physical plausibility of predictions (also known as Boltz-2x). Increases prediction time. Default = false

boltz_use_templates.description: Whether to use template structures to guide Boltz-2 predictions. Template is generated from input design structure. For monomer modes: uses chain A as template. For binder modes: uses chain B (target) as template only, similar to AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess.

boltz_template_force.description: Whether to enforce template structure using a potential (force constraint). Only applies if boltz_use_templates=true.

boltz_template_threshold.description: Distance threshold in Angstroms that the prediction can deviate from the template e.g. 1. Only applies if boltz_use_templates=true. If null, no distance threshold is applied.

boltz_input_msa.description: Path to a multiple sequence alignment (.a3m format) for the input PDB. Applies to chain B in binder modes or chain A in monomer modes. If null, single-sequence mode is used.

boltz_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to Boltz-2 that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '--msa_pairing_strategy complete'

boltz_predict_unbound_binder.description: Also predict the binder alone (no target) as a target-free monomer prediction with Boltz-2, to check whether the binder folds consistently to the design in the absence of the target. Binder design modes only. Runs as a pure single-sequence prediction (no template, no MSA).

fold_max_helices.description: Maximum number of alpha-helices allowed. e.g. 6

fold_max_strands.description: Maximum number of beta-strands allowed. e.g. 6

fampnn_max_psce.description: Max PSCE score for designed side-chains. A lower score means FAMPNN is more confident in the sequence.

af2_min_iptm.description: Min predicted interface TM-score (ipTM) between binder and target e.g. 0.8

af2_max_pae_interaction.description: Max predicted aligned error for interactions e.g. 10

af2_max_pae_overall.description: Max predicted aligned error for all chains e.g. 10

af2_max_pae_binder.description: Max predicted aligned error for binder e.g. 5

af2_max_pae_target.description: Max predicted aligned error for target e.g. 5

af2_min_plddt_target.description: Min pLDDT score required for target e.g 90

af2_max_rmsd_binder_bndaln.description: Max binder RMSD when binder chains are aligned e.g. 1

af2_max_rmsd_binder_tgtaln.description: Max binder RMSD when target chains are aligned e.g. 2

af2_max_rmsd_target.description: Max target RMSD when target chains are aligned e.g. 2

boltz_max_rmsd_overall.description: Max RMSD between all chains of Boltz-2 prediction and input design. e.g. 2.5

boltz_max_rmsd_binder.description: Max RMSD between binder chains of Boltz-2 prediction and input design. e.g. 1.5

boltz_max_rmsd_target.description: Max RMSD between target chains of Boltz-2 prediction and input design. e.g. 1

boltz_min_ptm_binder.description: Minimum predicted TM-score of binder chain e.g. 0.8

boltz_min_ptm_target.description: Minimum predicted TM-score of target chain e.g. 0.9

boltz_min_iptm.description: Minimum predicted TM-score of binder-target interface e.g. 0.85

boltz_min_iplddt.description: Minimum pLDDT score of the binder-target interface e.g. 0.8

boltz_max_ipde.description: Maximum predicted distance error for the binder-target interface e.g 12

boltz_min_ipSAE_min.description: Minimum value allowed for the minimum interaction Prediction Score from Aligned Errors (ipSAE) of target and binder chains (0 to 1)

boltz_min_pDockQ2_min.description: Minimum value allowed for the minimum predicted DockQ Score v2 of target and binder chains (0 to 1)

boltz_max_pae_interaction.description: Maximum predicted aligned error at interaction interfaces (0 to ~30 Angstroms)

boltz_max_unbound_rmsd.description: Max C-alpha RMSD between the unbound (target-free) binder prediction and the design. Requires boltz_predict_unbound_binder=true.

boltz_min_unbound_conf_score.description: Minimum confidence score of the unbound (target-free) binder prediction. Requires boltz_predict_unbound_binder=true.

boltz_min_unbound_ptm.description: Minimum pTM score of the unbound (target-free) binder prediction. Requires boltz_predict_unbound_binder=true.

boltz_min_unbound_plddt.description: Minimum pLDDT score of the unbound (target-free) binder prediction. Requires boltz_predict_unbound_binder=true.

boltz_max_unbound_pde.description: Maximum PDE score of the unbound (target-free) binder prediction. Requires boltz_predict_unbound_binder=true.

pr_min_helices.description: Minimum number of alpha-helices in predicted structure

pr_max_helices.description: Maximum number of alpha-helices in predicted structure

pr_min_strands.description: Minimum number of beta-strands in predicted structure

pr_max_strands.description: Maximum number of beta-strands in predicted structure

pr_max_total_ss.description: Maximum total secondary structure elements (α-helices + β-strands) in predicted structure

pr_min_rog.description: Minimum radius of gyration (Å) of predicted structure

pr_max_rog.description: Maximum radius of gyration (Å) of predicted structure

pr_min_intface_bsa.description: Minimum buried surface area (Å²) at the binding interface

pr_max_intface_unsat_hbonds.description: Maximum number of buried, unsatisfied hydrogen bonds at the interface

pr_max_intface_deltagtobsa.description: Maximum ratio of delta-G to buried surface area

pr_max_surfhphobics.description: Maximum percentage of hydrophobic residues exposed on the surface

seq_min_pi.description: Minimum isoelectric point (pI) of the sequence

seq_max_pi.description: Maximum isoelectric point (pI) of the sequence

num_designs.description: Number of designs to generate using RFdiffusion or Bindcraft.

seqs_per_design.description: Number of sequences to generate per design.

input_pdb.description: Path to an input PDB file. e.g. 'target.pdb'

flexible_residues.description: Residues whose structure should NOT be conditioned on (BoltzGen structure_groups visibility=0 / RFdiffusion contigmap.inpaint_str), useful for disordered/flexible regions e.g. loops or IDPs. Comma-separated tokens, each a chain-qualified residue e.g. 'B16', a chain-qualified range e.g. 'B10-13', or a bare chain ID e.g. 'C' meaning the whole chain is flexible. In boltzgen_motifscaff/rfd_motifscaff mode this may also reference chain A residues kept by motifscaff_spec. Used by boltzgen_denovo, boltzgen_motifscaff, rfd_motifscaff, rfd_partialdiff, and binder design with rfd_denovo/rfd_foldcond.

motifscaff_spec.description: Chain A architecture spec: an ordered, comma-separated list of chain-A 'keep' tokens (e.g. 'A10-50' or 'A60') and bare-digit 'insert' tokens (e.g. '10' for an exact count or '7-10' for a sampled range), e.g. '7-10,A1-60,5,A70-100,10' inserts 7-10 residues at the N-terminus, keeps residues A1-60, inserts 5 residues, keeps A70-100, then appends 10 residues at the C-terminus. Any original chain A residue not covered by a keep token is deleted. If null, chain A's architecture (length) is left unchanged. Used by boltzgen_motifscaff and rfd_motifscaff.

motifscaff_inpaint_seq.description: Chain A residues, within those kept by motifscaff_spec, whose sequence is allowed to change while their structure stays fixed/conditioned, comma-separated e.g. 'A10-50,A60'. Used by boltzgen_motifscaff and rfd_motifscaff.

bg_not_binding_residues.description: Target residues the binder should NOT contact. Comma-separated tokens, each a chain-qualified residue e.g. 'A200', a chain-qualified range e.g. 'A210-215', or a bare chain ID e.g. 'B' meaning the whole chain. Optional for boltzgen_denovo and boltzgen_motifscaff binder design modes. e.g. 'A200,A210-215,B'.

bg_use_kernels.description: Whether BoltzGen uses its cuEquivariance GPU kernels. Choose from 'auto' (use kernels if the GPU compute capability is >= 8), 'true' or 'false'. Set to 'false' on AMD/ROCm GPUs, where the kernels are unavailable. Applies to boltzgen_denovo and boltzgen_motifscaff modes.

seq_method.description: Sequence design method. Choose from 'mpnn' (ProteinMPNN Fast-Relax) or 'fampnn' (Full-Atom MPNN).

pred_method.description: Structure prediction method. Choose from 'af2' (AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess), 'boltz' (Boltz-2), or 'af2_boltz' (run AF2 first, filter, then run Boltz-2 on the survivors).

zip_pdbs.description: Whether to compress output final designs in a tar.gz archive. If false, results will be output as uncompressed PDB files.

rank_designs.description: Whether to rank final designs by prediction quality metrics and output ranked_designs.

ranking_metric.description: Structure prediction metric to use for ranking designs (e.g., 'af2_pae_interaction', 'boltz_ipSAE_min', 'boltz_iptm'). Must match the prediction method prefix (af2_* for AlphaFold2, boltz_* for Boltz-2). If null, defaults to 'af2_pae_interaction' for AlphaFold2 or 'boltz_ipSAE_min' for Boltz-2.

max_designs.description: Maximum number of top-ranked designs to output (null = output all ranked designs)

max_seqs_per_fold.description: Maximum number of sequences per fold to keep after ranking (e.g. 4, null = no limit). Helps increase fold diversity.

run_fold_only.description: Whether to run fold design only and skip downstream stages (i.e. sequence design, prediction, and analysis)

skip_fold.description: Skip Fold Design and run Sequence Design, Structure Prediction, and Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_fold_seq.description: Skip Fold Design and Sequence Design, and run Structure Prediction and Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_fold_seq_pred.description: Skip Fold Design, Sequence Design, and Structure Prediction, and run Analysis only. Must provide 'skip_input_dir' directory below containing PDB and JSON files with metadata. Binder design PDBs must have binder as chain A and target as chain B.

skip_input_dir.description: Path to input files when skipping stages e.g. './rfd_results'

mpnn_omitAAs.description: A string of all residue types (one letter case-insensitive) to avoid for design. Default: CX

mpnn_temperature.description: Temperature for sequence sampling. Higher values increase sequence diversity.

mpnn_checkpoint_type.description: Checkpoint type to use for ProteinMPNN. Choose from 'vanilla', 'soluble' or 'hyper' (default = 'soluble').

mpnn_checkpoint_model.description: Checkpoint model to use for ProteinMPNN. Indicates noise level used during training for backbone atoms.  Choose from 'v_48_002','v_48_010,'v_48_020','v_48_030'. (default = 'v_48_020', noised with 0.20Å Gaussian noise)

mpnn_backbone_noise.description: Standard deviation of Gaussian noise to add to backbone atoms. 0 = no change to backbone, 0.1-0.3 = allows mild perturbation of backbone.

mpnn_relax_max_cycles.description: Maximum number of fast relax cycles to run on each sequence. Set to zero to disable.

mpnn_relax_seqs_per_cycle.description: Number of sequences to generate between relaxation steps. The sequence with the best score will be kept.

mpnn_relax_output.description: Whether to run a relaxation cycle before saving output.

mpnn_relax_convergence_rmsd.description: Design is considered converged if the C-alpha RMSD (Å) between cycles is <= this threshold.

mpnn_relax_convergence_score.description: Design is considered converged if the improvement in score between cycles is <= this threshold.

mpnn_relax_convergence_max_cycles.description: Design is considered converged if it meets both convergence criteria for n consecutive cycles.

mpnn_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to ProteinMPNN-OpenMMRelax that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '-protein_features="full"'

fampnn_fix_target_sidechains.description: Fix target side-chain positions when performing binder sequence design (default: false)

fampnn_psce_threshold.description: Only keep sidechains below this PSCE threshold during design; null to keep all.

fampnn_temperature.description: Temperature for sequence sampling. Higher values increase sequence diversity.

fampnn_exclude_cys.description: Exclude cysteine residues from sequence design.

fampnn_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to Full-Atom MPNN that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. 'timestep_schedule.num_steps=100 seq_only=true'

uncropped_target_pdb.description: Path to uncropped target PDB file to use in structure prediction e.g. 'benchmarkdata/5o45_pd-l1_uncropped.pdb'

af2_initial_guess.description: Use an initial-guess of the target chain(s) when performing binder structure prediction. When false, AF2 will not use an initial guess. Default = true

af2_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '-recycle 3'

boltz_recycling_steps.description: The number of recycling steps to use for prediction.

boltz_diffusion_samples.description: The number of diffusion samples to use for prediction.

boltz_sampling_steps.description: The number of sampling steps to use for prediction.

boltz_use_potentials.description: Use physics-based potentials during inference to improve physical plausibility of predictions (also known as Boltz-2x). Increases prediction time. Default = false

boltz_use_templates.description: Whether to use template structures to guide Boltz-2 predictions. Template is generated from input design structure. For monomer modes: uses chain A as template. For binder modes: uses chain B (target) as template only, similar to AlphaFold2 Initial-Guess.

boltz_template_force.description: Whether to enforce template structure using a potential (force constraint). Only applies if boltz_use_templates=true.

boltz_template_threshold.description: Distance threshold in Angstroms that the prediction can deviate from the template e.g. 1. Only applies if boltz_use_templates=true. If null, no distance threshold is applied.

boltz_input_msa.description: Path to a multiple sequence alignment (.a3m format) for the input PDB. Applies to chain B in binder modes or chain A in monomer modes. If null, single-sequence mode is used.

boltz_extra_config.description: Additional configuration parameters to pass to Boltz-2 that are not externalised in Nextflow. e.g. '--msa_pairing_strategy complete'

boltz_predict_unbound_binder.description: Also predict the binder alone (no target) as a target-free monomer prediction with Boltz-2, to check whether the binder folds consistently to the design in the absence of the target. Binder design modes only. Runs as a pure single-sequence prediction (no template, no MSA).
